description: Accepts a `Draggable`'s payload dropped on it; its child is highlighted while a candidate hovers.

props.name: accepts
props.description: When set, only a `Draggable` whose `data` equals it is accepted.

props.name: highlightColor
props.description: Tints the child while an acceptable candidate hovers over it.

events.name: onAccept
events.description: Fired when a candidate was dropped and accepted; the runtime passes the dropped `data` as the event payload.

events.name: onLeave
events.description: Fired when a candidate leaves without being dropped.

slots.name: child
slots.description: The content; it is highlighted while a candidate hovers.

excluded.note: Keys are derived from node identifiers.
